name: RAHUL FERROMET & ENGINEERING PVT. LTD.
capabilities: Ultra-high-purity stainless steel tubes and fittings
india_angle: Rahul Ferromet & Engineering Pvt. Ltd. operates a 20,000 m² manufacturing facility in Jhagadia, Bharuch, Gujarat, India, producing high-quality stainless steel tubes.
summary: Rahul Ferromet & Engineering Pvt. Ltd., under the Rensa brand, manufactures ultra-high-purity stainless steel tubes and fittings for semiconductor fabs and advanced technology facilities. Their products are engineered for UHP process-gas distribution and other high-purity media applications, with capabilities in electropolishing and precision manufacturing.
